suite: Crystal Orbit experience — chat acceptance baseline

scenarios.title: Admin and member share the same canonical landing
expected: Crystal Orbit loads without requiring an /admin-specific landing
Admin is presented as a member with additional provisioned worlds

scenarios.title: Provisioned universe contains at least two selectable worlds
expected: My Account and Salt Basin Member are present
Licensed organization worlds are added from entitlements and memberships

scenarios.title: Solar-system camera scene remains the primary navigation
expected: Camera responds spatially
Crystal planets retain rings, lighting and depth
No flat-card fallback replaces the primary scene

scenarios.title: Entering a world reveals a 3D city plus operational panels
steps: Enter the center crystal or a named world
expected: 3D scene remains visible
Capability buildings, flowing rivers, journey dock, health and dashboard cards coexist

scenarios.title: Organization world is client-scoped
expected: World label identifies the organization
Workspace receives organization scope and does not expose another organization's records

scenarios.title: Definition-to-operation journey is visible and enterable
expected: Journey appears in the dock
Animated governed gates and spatial structures open inside the world

scenarios.title: Career Foundation follows the governed evidence process
expected: Coordinates are Upload source documents, Parse and map evidence, Review recommended mappings, Define jobs and roles, Link skills, tools, and projects, Approve Career Master

scenarios.title: Resume or workbook upload produces recommendations without saving
steps: Upload a supported resume or semantic workbook
expected: Editable recommendations appear inside the journey
Career Master is unchanged until Confirm & Save

scenarios.title: Mapping review supports field-level edits and exclusions
expected: Only included reviewed values commit
Created, updated, skipped and error outcomes remain distinguishable

scenarios.title: Committed mappings retain field-level source lineage
expected: Source filename or source kind points to a Career Atom
Source location and target record identity are preserved

scenarios.title: Committed evidence visibly forms career structures
expected: Jobs, skills, tools and engagements appear as animated crystal structures
Formation does not cover the stage rail or controls

scenarios.title: Maturity calculation is transparent and deterministic
expected: Maturity shows gate completion ×45%, evidence coverage ×30%, approval coverage ×15%, lineage coverage ×10%
Displayed total equals the rounded weighted sum

scenarios.title: Data integrity calculation is transparent and deterministic
expected: Integrity shows completeness ×40%, traceability ×30%, validation ×20%, freshness ×10%
Traceability is based on distinct committed field mappings

scenarios.title: Tablet panels remain proportionate and collapsible
expected: Scene remains materially visible
Controls do not cover the full viewport
Stage rail and inspector remain usable

scenarios.title: Mobile journey operation prioritizes the active scene
expected: Large inspector is hidden during embedded operation
Scrollable operation fits between header and stage rail
No horizontal page overflow

scenarios.title: Account Crystal exposes member identity, entitlements and logout
steps: Click Log out of Salt Basin
expected: Emails, organizations, licenses and email permission are visible
Logout clears the session and navigates to /login

scenarios.title: Outbound email is fail-closed without authorization
expected: No provider request is made
Result is recipient_confirmation_required

scenarios.title: Automatic email requires explicit member confirmation and recipient attribute
expected: Preference records confirmation time
Only a workflow declaring the same member and recipient attribute can dispatch
Preference changes are audited

scenarios.title: LoneTree demo seed cannot infer a target member
expected: Script refuses to run
No secondary email, membership or entitlement is created

scenarios.title: Visual graphics never regress to a flat deployment
steps: Inspect orbit, entered world and journey at all three viewports
expected: WebGL/Three scene remains mounted
Crystal imagery, spatial depth, motion and dashboard overlays are present
Reduced-motion support may reduce animation but not remove the spatial information architecture
